purpose: Register intended hypotheses only; NOT an executed backtest, no source of fabricated PnL
explanation: Templates only. Numeric signal parameters must be frozen and hash-pinned before collecting a fresh prospective holdout; none is eligible as confirmatory until then.

strategies.signal_rule_description: Public wallet swap observed only after valid chain confirmation and a source timestamp; enter next executable quote after delay, same token/pool and permitted $100 sizing; respect missing liquidity and tokens
strategies.independent_benchmark: Same-capital no-trade and eligible buy/hold as benchmarks
strategies.rejection_conditions: Any unresolved timestamp, missing cost mark or unacceptable quote impact => no trade
strategies.evaluation_period: Future new untouched on-chain price/liquidity observations; prior 2026-10-13 holdout expressly excluded
strategies.qualification: At least one unseen chronological holdout, rigorous cost-aware fills, wallet/time selection controls, bootstrap with multiplicity awareness, and sufficient prospective track record; reject without evidence
